cases.body:
﻿"";"MARE NOSTRUM FINE FOODS";"";"Printed on";"<today>"
"";"International text";"";"";""
"The same message in nine languages and eight scripts: shaped, right to left where needed, with its fonts embedded in the PDF";"";"";"";""
"Language";"";"Text";"";""
"";"";"Thank you for your order";"";""
"English";"";"";"";""
"Latin";"";"";"";""
"";"";"Our extra virgin olive oil is cold pressed from Arbequina olives harvested in October, and bottled within hours to keep its fruity aroma.";"";""
"";"";"Gracias por su pedido";"";""
"Spanish";"";"";"";""
"Latin";"";"";"";""
"";"";"Nuestro aceite de oliva virgen extra se prensa en frío a partir de aceitunas arbequinas cosechadas en octubre, y se embotella en pocas horas para conservar su aroma afrutado.";"";""
"";"";"Ευχαριστούμε για την παραγγελία σας";"";""
"Greek";"";"";"";""
"Greek";"";"";"";""
"";"";"Το εξαιρετικό παρθένο ελαιόλαδό μας παράγεται με ψυχρή έκθλιψη από ελιές Arbequina που συλλέγονται τον Οκτώβριο, και εμφιαλώνεται μέσα σε λίγες ώρες για να διατηρήσει το φρουτώδες άρωμά του.";"";""
"";"";"Спасибо за ваш заказ";"";""
"Russian";"";"";"";""
"Cyrillic";"";"";"";""
"";"";"Наше оливковое масло extra virgin холодного отжима делается из оливок сорта арбекина, собранных в октябре, и разливается за несколько часов, чтобы сохранить фруктовый аромат.";"";""
"";"";"شكرًا لك على طلبك";"";""
"Arabic";"";"";"";""
"Arabic, right to left";"";"";"";""
"";"";"يُعصر زيت الزيتون البكر الممتاز لدينا على البارد من زيتون أربيكينا المقطوف في شهر أكتوبر، ويُعبأ في غضون ساعات قليلة للحفاظ على رائحته الفاكهية.";"";""
"";"";"תודה על ההזמנה שלך";"";""
"Hebrew";"";"";"";""
"Hebrew, right to left";"";"";"";""
"";"";"שמן הזית הכתית המעולה שלנו מופק בכבישה קרה מזיתי ארבקינה הנקטפים באוקטובר, ומבוקבק תוך שעות ספורות כדי לשמור על הארומה הפירותית שלו.";"";""
"";"";"आपके ऑर्डर के लिए धन्यवाद";"";""
"Hindi";"";"";"";""
"Devanagari";"";"";"";""
"";"";"हमारा एक्स्ट्रा वर्जिन जैतून का तेल अक्टूबर में तोड़े गए अर्बेक्विना जैतूनों की ठंडी पेराई से बनता है और उसकी फल जैसी सुगंध बनाए रखने के लिए कुछ ही घंटों में बोतलबंद किया जाता है।";"";""
"";"";"ขอบคุณสำหรับคำสั่งซื้อของคุณ";"";""
"Thai";"";"";"";""
"Thai";"";"";"";""
"";"";"น้ำมันมะกอกของเราสกัดเย็นจากมะกอกที่เก็บเกี่ยวในเดือนตุลาคม";"";""
"";"";"ご注文ありがとうございます";"";""
"Japanese";"";"";"";""
"Japanese";"";"";"";""
"";"";"当店のオリーブオイルは、10月に収穫したアルベキーナ種を低温圧搾しています。";"";""

items.title: Peces (clásico)
items.description: El ejemplo clásico de Report Manager: grupos por categoría, notas largas que continúan en la página siguiente, imágenes guardadas en la base de datos y un gráfico.
items.prompt: In the dataset FISH order the fishes of each category by length, longest first, and print the species name under the common name

items.title: Clientes por país
items.description: Un listado agrupado por país, con las cabeceras de columna repetidas en cada página, un recuento por grupo y el total general.
items.prompt: Add the email of each customer to the dataset CUST and show it in the report as a new column after the phone

items.title: Facturas
items.description: Una factura por página: cliente, líneas del pedido, descuentos, IVA y totales. Pide el rango de pedidos a imprimir.
items.prompt: Add the EAN-13 code of each product to the dataset INV and print it in the order lines after the SKU

items.title: Carta a clientes (texto HTML)
items.description: Una carta personalizada para cada cliente: texto con marcas HTML (negrita, cursiva, subrayado, colores y otra fuente) en párrafos que crecen con su texto.
items.prompt: Add the phone of each customer to the dataset LET and print it under the address of the letter

items.title: Ventas por categoría
items.description: Las ventas de un año agrupadas por categoría con subtotales, y un resumen con gráfico de barras sobre un segundo conjunto de datos.
items.prompt: Add the number of orders of each product to the dataset PROD as ORDER_COUNT and show it as a new column after the units

items.title: Catálogo de productos
items.description: Productos con códigos de barras EAN-13; el stock por debajo del mínimo se resalta con impresión condicional.
items.prompt: Add the stock value of each product (units in stock by unit price) to the dataset CAT as STOCK_VALUE and print it as a new column after the stock

items.title: Ventas mensuales
items.description: Pedidos y ventas por mes entre dos fechas que se piden como parámetros, con totales, medias y un gráfico de columnas.
items.prompt: Add the number of different customers of each month to the dataset MON as CUSTOMERS and show it as a new column after the orders

items.title: Etiquetas de direcciones
items.description: Etiquetas con la dirección de los clientes, tres por fila en hojas A4 (70 x 36 mm), con el desplazamiento horizontal de la sección de detalle.
items.prompt: Add the customer code to the dataset ADDR as CUSTOMER_CODE and print it in small type in the top right corner of each label

items.title: Texto internacional
items.description: El mismo mensaje en nueve idiomas y ocho escrituras: árabe y hebreo de derecha a izquierda, devanagari, tailandés y japonés, con las fuentes incrustadas en el PDF.
items.prompt: Add the greeting number GREETING_ID to the columns of the dataset G and print it before the language name

items.title: Directorio de contactos (unión)
items.description: Clientes y empleados en una sola lista: un conjunto de datos en memoria que reúne las filas de dos consultas, una tras otra (una unión de conjuntos de datos), agrupadas por tipo de contacto.
items.prompt: In the dataset CUSTOMER_CONTACTS order the customers by their company name instead of by the contact name, and print the company name before the contact name in the directory

items.title: Comparativa anual (unión en paralelo)
items.description: Las ventas de dos años lado a lado: las uniones en paralelo ponen las columnas de dos conjuntos de datos en la misma fila, emparejadas por categoría, o por posición para los diez productos más vendidos de cada año.
items.prompt: Add the units sold of each category in each year to the datasets CATEGORY_FIRST and CATEGORY_SECOND as UNITS, and show them in the Sales by category table next to the orders of each year

items.title: Fishes (classic)
items.description: The classic Report Manager sample: groups by category, long notes that flow across pages, pictures stored in the database and a chart.
items.prompt: In the dataset FISH order the fishes of each category by length, longest first, and print the species name under the common name

items.title: Customers by country
items.description: A list grouped by country, with the column headings repeated on every page, a count per group and the grand total.
items.prompt: Add the email of each customer to the dataset CUST and show it in the report as a new column after the phone

items.title: Invoices
items.description: One invoice per page: customer, order lines, discounts, VAT and totals. It asks for the range of orders to print.
items.prompt: Add the EAN-13 code of each product to the dataset INV and print it in the order lines after the SKU

items.title: Customer letter (HTML text)
items.description: A personalised letter for each customer: text with HTML marks (bold, italics, underline, colours and another font) in paragraphs that grow with their text.
items.prompt: Add the phone of each customer to the dataset LET and print it under the address of the letter

items.title: Sales by category
items.description: The sales of a year grouped by category with subtotals, and a summary with a bar chart from a second dataset.
items.prompt: Add the number of orders of each product to the dataset PROD as ORDER_COUNT and show it as a new column after the units

items.title: Product catalogue
items.description: Products with EAN-13 barcodes; the stock below the reorder level is highlighted with conditional printing.
items.prompt: Add the stock value of each product (units in stock by unit price) to the dataset CAT as STOCK_VALUE and print it as a new column after the stock

items.title: Monthly sales
items.description: Orders and sales by month between two dates given as parameters, with totals, averages and a column chart.
items.prompt: Add the number of different customers of each month to the dataset MON as CUSTOMERS and show it as a new column after the orders

items.title: Address labels
items.description: Customer address labels, three per row on A4 sheets (70 x 36 mm), with the horizontal displacement of the detail section.
items.prompt: Add the customer code to the dataset ADDR as CUSTOMER_CODE and print it in small type in the top right corner of each label

items.title: International text
items.description: The same message in nine languages and eight scripts: Arabic and Hebrew from right to left, Devanagari, Thai and Japanese, with the fonts embedded in the PDF.
items.prompt: Add the greeting number GREETING_ID to the columns of the dataset G and print it before the language name

items.title: Contact directory (union)
items.description: Customers and employees in one list: an in-memory dataset that joins the rows of two queries, one after the other (a union of datasets), grouped by kind of contact.
items.prompt: In the dataset CUSTOMER_CONTACTS order the customers by their company name instead of by the contact name, and print the company name before the contact name in the directory

items.title: Year over year (parallel union)
items.description: The sales of two years side by side: parallel unions put the columns of two datasets in the same row, matched by category, or by position for the ten best sold products of each year.

dataInfo.sql: SELECT C.NAME AS CATEGORY, P.SKU, P.NAME AS PRODUCT, SUM(L.QUANTITY) AS UNITS, SUM(L.QUANTITY*L.UNIT_PRICE*(1-L.DISCOUNT/100.0)) AS SALES FROM ORDER_LINES L JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_ID = L.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = L.PRODUCT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', O.ORDER_DATE) AS INTEGER) = :SALES_YEAR GROUP BY C.NAME, P.SKU, P.NAME ORDER BY C.NAME, SALES DESC
dataInfo.name: TRpDataInfoItem0

dataInfo.sql: SELECT C.NAME AS CATEGORY, SUM(L.QUANTITY) AS UNITS, SUM(L.QUANTITY*L.UNIT_PRICE*(1-L.DISCOUNT/100.0)) AS SALES, 100.0 * SUM(L.QUANTITY*L.UNIT_PRICE*(1-L.DISCOUNT/100.0)) / (SELECT SUM(L.QUANTITY*L.UNIT_PRICE*(1-L.DISCOUNT/100.0)) FROM ORDER_LINES L JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_ID = L.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = L.PRODUCT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', O.ORDER_DATE) AS INTEGER) = :SALES_YEAR ) AS SHARE FROM ORDER_LINES L JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_ID = L.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = L.PRODUCT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', O.ORDER_DATE) AS INTEGER) = :SALES_YEAR GROUP BY C.NAME ORDER BY SALES DESC

<SQL type="String">SELECT C.NAME AS CATEGORY#44# P.SKU#44# P
.NAME AS PRODUCT#44# SUM(L.QUANTITY) AS U
NITS#44# SUM(L.QUANTITY#42#L.UNIT_PRICE#42#
(1#45#L.DISCOUNT#47#100.0)) AS SALES FROM
 ORDER_LINES L JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_I
D = L.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.PRODU
CT_ID = L.PRODUCT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES C ON
 C.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID WHERE CAST
(strftime(#39##37#Y#39##44# O.ORDER_DATE)
 AS INTEGER) = :SALES_YEAR GROUP BY C.NAM
E#44# P.SKU#44# P.NAME ORDER BY C.NAME#44#
 SALES DESC</SQL>

columns.name: CODE
columns.context: Customer code printed on the documents, for example 'C0001'.

columns.name: COUNTRY
columns.context: Country name in English.

columns.name: VAT_RATE
columns.context: VAT percentage charged to the customer: 21 means 21 %. It is 0 for customers outside the European Union.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SINCE
columns.context: Date of the first order. ISO text 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

schemaTables.name: EMPLOYEES
schemaTables.context: The sales staff. The orders of a customer are taken by an employee of the region of its country.

columns.name: HIRE_DATE
columns.context: ISO text 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

columns.name: REGION
columns.context: Sales region the employee covers.

allowedValues.label: France, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium and Switzerland
United Kingdom, United States, Mexico and Argentina

schemaTables.name: FISHES
schemaTables.context: Fish species of the classic Report Manager sample (the biolife table); not related to the sales tables.

columns.name: SPECIES_NAME
columns.context: Scientific (Latin) name of the species.

columns.name: NOTES
columns.context: Long description of the species: habitat, behaviour, whether it is edible.

columns.name: GRAPHIC
columns.context: Picture of the fish (JPEG). Not for queries.

schemaTables.name: GREETINGS
schemaTables.context: The same thank-you message in nine languages, for the international text sample; not related to the sales tables.

columns.name: NATIVE_NAME
columns.context: Name of the language written in the language itself.

columns.name: DIRECTION
columns.context: Direction of the script.

allowedValues.label: Written from right to left (Arabic, Hebrew)

columns.name: PARAGRAPH
columns.context: A paragraph about the olive oil of the company, in the same language.

schemaTables.name: ORDER_LINES
schemaTables.context: The products of each order. The amount of a line is QUANTITY * UNIT_PRICE * (1 - DISCOUNT / 100.0).

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE
columns.context: Price of one unit in this order, in euros, without VAT.

columns.name: DISCOUNT
columns.context: Discount percentage of the line.

allowedValues.label: 5 % volume discount, only on lines of 12 units or more
10 % volume discount, only on lines of 12 units or more

schemaTables.name: ORDERS
schemaTables.context: One row per sales order (invoice). The amounts are not stored here: the net amount of an order is the sum of the amounts of its ORDER_LINES, its VAT is net amount * VAT_RATE / 100.0 and its total is net amount + VAT.

columns.name: ORDER_NUMBER
columns.context: Order and invoice number, 'YYYY/NNNNN', for example '2024/00001'.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_ID
columns.context: Sales representative who took the order.

columns.name: ORDER_DATE
columns.context: ISO text 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

columns.name: SHIP_DATE
columns.context: NULL while the order is pending. ISO text 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.context: Shipping state of the order.

allowedValues.label: Not shipped yet: SHIP_DATE is NULL

columns.name: VAT_RATE
columns.context: VAT percentage of the order (21 means 21 %), copied from the customer.

foreignKeys.relationshipContext: The sales representative who took the order.

columns.name: EAN13
